frequency_question: How often do labor federations successfully clear all procedural notice and conciliation steps to launch an indefinite strike within a 46-day window from initial formal call?
membership_rule: Includes multi-union industry-wide federation strike ballots and statutory notice periods; excludes single-unit or wildcat strikes lacking formal statutory frameworks.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; believed roughly 3 in total for this specific multi-year cluster
known_gaps: Focuses strictly on successful procedural completions without evaluating intent.
skeleton: 3 historical industry-wide strike cycles meeting the statutory notice threshold within tight calendar windows, divided by total observed major call cycles in the decade.
multiplier: 3 observed successful execution cycles / 3 total attempted statutory countdown cycles
validity_reason: Statutory labor dispute timelines and conciliation frameworks remain stable under current labor legislation acts.
